mapper.select: SELECT groupId, groupName, groupHead FROM `group` where groupId = #{groupId}

SELECT u.userId, u.userNickName,g.groupId,g.groupName,g.groupHead FROM user as u LEFT JOIN user_group as ug ON u.userId=ug.userId LEFT JOIN `group` as g ON ug.groupId=g.groupId WHERE u.userId=#{userId}
SELECT u.userId AS friendId, u.userNickName AS friendName, u.userHead AS friendHead FROM `user` u LEFT JOIN user_group ug ON u.userId = ug.userId WHERE ug.groupId = #{groupId}
